The schedule from my earlier answer holds. The team note's claim doesn't, because it contradicts the constraints.

**Why the note fails:** It puts Ivo in slot 6 and Ann in slot 7. Ann is immediately after Dev, so Dev would be in slot 6. But Dev must come before Ivo, and Ivo is already in slot 6. Also, Hana doesn't have to be last. Ann only has to come before Hana.

**Check of the schedule** (Finn 1, Ben 2, Elif 3, Gus 4, Dev 5, Ann 6, Ivo 7, Hana 8, Cara 9):
- Finn (1) is before Dev (5).
- Elif (3) is between Ben (2) and Gus (4), so exactly one person separates Ben and Gus. Ben is before Gus, and Gus is immediately after Elif.
- Dev (5) is before Ivo (7).
- Hana (8) is between Ivo (7) and Cara (9), so exactly one person separates Cara and Ivo.
- Ivo (7) is before Cara (9).
- Ann (6) is immediately after Dev (5).
- Elif (3) is before Ann (6), and Ann (6) is before Hana (8).
- Ben (2) is before Dev (5) and before Ivo (7).
- Elif (3) is before Cara (9).
- Cara–Finn is 8 apart, Ann–Cara is 3, Ann–Finn is 5, and Cara–Elif is 6. All are at least 3.
